svg.title: OSDU Delivery: Component diagram for the compute node
svg.desc: A node takes its work outbound from the control plane, so it runs next to the data; rows flow left to right into OSDU and the ledger.
svg.text: Component diagram for the compute node
A node takes its work outbound from the control plane, so it runs next to the data; rows flow left to right into OSDU and the ledger.

g.title: Control plane: SQLFlow's control plane (.NET 9) with DeliveryControlPlaneModule: the REST API (the delivery API under /api/v1/delivery), identity and tokens, the managed git sync, schedules, the run queue and dispatcher, the node protocol, the chat assistant, and the module's background services. It decides what runs and owns the state; it runs no flow itself.

Estate repository: The estate as YAML and JSON files in git: flows, mappings, templates, cache definitions, schedules, assertions and AI contexts. A run executes the commit the control plane last synced, never a working copy.

Key Vault: osdu-kv-<suffix>, RBAC only. Terraform writes the connection strings (no credential in them); the setup script generates the JWT signing key, the first admin's password and the node token when missing; a person puts in each partition's client secret and the GitHub App's key.

Node runtime: SQLFlow's worker verb with the module installed: polls the control plane with its node token, takes runs and node tasks into its slots (four by default), checks out the commit each run is pinned to, resolves ${env:...} and ${keyvault:...} references with its own identity, and drains running work before it stops.
g.text: Polls, runs four at once, resolves references,

g.title: OSDU executors: One executor per OSDU flow kind (delivery, retrieval, cache, assertion, dimension, inventory, removal, download) behind SQLFlow's DocumentExecutor. A delivery run plans into a submission and work batches, then drains them under leases; a large one fans out a part per 1,000 rows, on up to eight nodes.
g.text: The eight OSDU kinds; plans and drains deliveries.

g.title: Landing storage: A storage account with a hierarchical namespace and shared keys off, container landing. Every run is given its location as LANDING_URL (abfss://landing@<account>.dfs.core.windows.net): the source files the file flows land, the bulk payload files deliveries send, and work batch files when a flow writes them there.

SQLFlow engine: SQLFlow's own flows, unchanged: a file flow lands the source files into a pre table as text with FileName_DW and RowNumber_DW and refreshes its typed view; an ing flow upserts the view into a keyed ingestion table and stamps UpdatedDate_DW on every row it changes.

Intake: Reads the rows of the ingestion table and its children whose UpdatedDate_DW moved since the last run (with a short overlap), has each one rendered, and compares its hash with what the ledger last delivered: unchanged records are skipped, changed ones planned into work batches.

Renderer: Renders a row through the mapping the flow pins (Name@version), against the template that mapping pins and the version of the partition's cache it reads from the catalog, and mints the record's id from the delivery key, so the same row always becomes the same record.

Routes: The protocol of each route: the storage service's batched writes, signed-URL file uploads, dataset registration, manifest ingestion through the workflow service, a DDMS's records and bulk data, workflow runs, the Production DDMS, and ETP 1.2 to the Reservoir DDMS. Legal tags are checked before a run; retries, rate limits and correlation ids on every call; OSDU tokens by client credentials.

OSDU data platform: A data partition's core services (Storage, Search, Schema, Legal, File, Dataset, Workflow, Entitlements) and its domain data management services (Wellbore, Reservoir over ETP, Production), which hold the delivered records and their bulk data.

Ingestion database: OsduData: the pre tables a file flow lands its files into, the keyed ingestion tables an ing flow upserts (stamping UpdatedDate_DW) and a delivery flow reads incrementally, and the tables dimension flows build. Snapshot isolation must be on.

Ledger: The only path to the ledger: submissions, records with their source file and row, render context and OSDU id and version, one append-only attempt per try, the audit trail, leases that let nodes share a submission, and the minted ids an unfinished delivery is undone by.

Catalog database: OsduDelivery: SQLFlow's catalog (pipelines, runs, schedules, lineage, users, conversations) and, beside it, the osdu schema with its own migrations: the ledger, the audit trail, cache versions, the index of the repository's templates, partitions and the central configuration.
